scope: Photographic same-camera/static-bin A/B conditional paired evidence, separate from controlled YCB paste truth. Fixed50 source pairs only; no model fitting authorized by this contract.

separate_from_controlled.YCB: Original observed maskpositive plus explicitly opaque independent paste produces controlled changed ownership; original full-only remainsunknown.
separate_from_controlled.Pallox: Real photographic pair with manually-prompted SAM teachers, supplied mesh/pose and measured depth. Evidence conditional on teacher ownership, geometry/calibration and registration; not the same provenance tier.

official_provenance.capture: Tripod; three heights0.55/1.23/1.92m, lab/hall; paired no-occlusion/cardboard-occlusion captures at each position.
official_provenance.file_order: Even/odd or lexical A/B order is NOT guaranteed as before/occluded. Use symmetricA/B, never even=unoccluded.
official_provenance.SAM: Paper describes manually selected prompt points followed by SAM; masks are teachers, not independent human dense-pixel ownership truth.
official_provenance.pose: Supplied annotations historically used PnP/RANSAC or depth-constrainedSVD in source work. Read stored4x4poses only; perform no newPnP/pose refinement.
official_provenance.mesh: Source mesh reconstructed withCOLMAP; source bin filled with random objects to vary appearance. Verify frame origin/scale and mismatching contents; supplied mesh is not exact physical truth.
official_provenance.instance: One physical pallet-bin instance; do not claim geometry/appearance generalization from this source.
official_provenance.family: User explicitly confirmed current223 are own captures unrelated to KU dataset. Separate source family admission plus image SHA denylist required; no private images are inspected.

initial_audit.fixtures: Literal0000/0001 in each of six sessions,12RGBDframes total; preserve earlier hash-sorted accidentalV1 fixtures as invalid/diagnostic.
initial_audit.symmetry: Report A andB visible support and both directions of depth change.
initial_audit.held_out_status: Fixed-six lab/hall source fixtures were inspected for provenance/geometry before full evidence preparation. Disclose this sourceVAL preview. No model/label thresholds chosen by those statistics.
initial_audit.geometry_replay: Two independent native mesh raster implementations: all six finite support masks and depths exactly equal, no crossing triangles. This checks implementation agreement only.

pair_admission_prerequisites: Both native RGB/depth/SAM have expected480x640 dimensions; source mm camera-Z interpretation is used. Missing/nonpositive/nonfinite depth yields no pixel evidence.
Supplied K and4x4object-to-camera pose matrices exactly equal between A/B; same session, source split, and static camera/bin are conditional source assumptions.
Supplied mesh raster: all vertices strictly in front, near_plane_crossing_triangles=0. Reject pair to UNKNOWN if geometric/metadata gates fail; no pose fitting or alignment repair.
Source mesh scale/object origin and supplied pose convention are the independently audited native renderer recipe; renderer correctness does not validate mesh truth.

RGB-depth registration is empirically supported by fixed-six inspection/residuals, NOT established by official dataset calibration metadata. This permits conditional TEACHER evidence only, never GOLD or registration-certified claims.
Same physical instance and photographic pair assumptions apply; cross-object, semantic-self or human corner labels are not created.

window_labels.exact: Unchanged native query nearest floor(q+.5); continuous androunded bounds.
window_labels.radius2: Clipped native5x5, separately supervised support target.
window_labels.E: Only if EVERY window pixel is visible-knownnegative andANY window pixel is certifiedfullpositive.
window_labels.O: Only if EVERY window pixel has separately admitted full-negative evidence.
window_labels.U: All remaining uncertain windows. Teacher0 or missing positives are not negatives.
window_labels.joint: Keep six allowed pair states and compatible-state partial facts; use window-minus-exact to respect shared-pixel correlation, never padU toO.
window_labels.strict_Ecore: All25pixels satisfy pair E evidence atnative resolution; clipping or depthmissing blocks strictcore.
window_labels.semantic_corner: No native-corner/self visibility ground truth is created; predictedOV is support/location uncertainty, not verified coordinate-error truth.

required_reports: Per initial fixture native-grid registration evidence, depthunit/range/Z facts and suppliedpose/K pair equality.
Before/after symmetric teacher-interior versus meshdepth residual distributions, finite support and no-nearclip checks.
Symmetric closer/farther/stable/missing depth counts,50/100/200gap strata withsame rules, no retrospective thresholdselection.
Perpixel acceptance reason/evidence tier andknown/unknown visible/full denominators.
Boundary/core, depthmissing, SAMteacher overlap andmeshagreement conflicts separately.
No O supervision when fullnegative certificate isunadmitted; all excluded pixels remainU.
Control YCB and paired photographic results stay separately reported; no gold/proxy provenance collapse.
limitations: Stable depth plusSAM can confuse coplanar/very-close occluders or cargo with target; Va/Vb are conditional teacher/geometry evidence, not goldvisible ownership.
Source mesh may miss thin/slatted geometry, contain reconstruction holes, or differ from filled bin. Agreement at positive pixels does not prove complete negative silhouette.
Hardwaredepth errors grow with distance; providedpositive depth alone is not measurement quality certification.
Pair metadata equality does not eliminate small motion, RGB/depth extrinsic misregistration or capture timing artifacts.
Initial fixture audit is data admission work, not a modelselection or real-evaluation performance result.
finalization: FROZEN before full50 paired-teacher generation. Preserve DRAFT and V1 diagnostic results. Any future negative/full geometry extension requires a separately versioned protocol, not mutation of this file.
freeze_basis: Parent approved conditional-teacher preparation after actual fixed-six native overlays and independent mesh raster agreement. No performance/model/threshold selection and no current223 data used.

constants.teacher_interior: erode2 native SAM positives with border0, predeclared source rule
constants.depth_valid: finite andpositive in verified commonmm camera-Z grid; retain supplied confidence/range flags ifavailable.
constants.mesh_tolerance: tau_i=max(20mm,0.01*D_i) using observed target-reference depth in that view.
constants.foreground_mesh_margin: For E_A use M-D_A>=max(50mm,2*tau_B) from visible B reference, mirror for E_B. Never use the closer occluder depth to shrink target-reference uncertainty.
constants.sensitivity_policy: Only pair-depth-gap is varied descriptively for initial source noise analysis; this does not choose a finalmodelthreshold or a private setting.

pixel_facts.full_positive: V_A OR V_B, shared by A/B, under conditional same-camera/static-bin assumptions; retained even if the other frame has UNKNOWN visibility.
pixel_facts.full_negative: DISABLED. Always Boolean zeros in this version, including renderer background and SAM0. Therefore no O hard labels are produced.
pixel_facts.mesh_outside_proxy: Save separately for audit; never silently map it to controlled/pairedO.
pixel_facts.visible_negative_A: E_A only. No source SAM-negative completeness assumption. B uses E_B.
pixel_facts.visible_negative_B: E_B only. All other non-V_B pixels remain visible-UNKNOWN.
pixel_facts.conflicts: Assert V_A&E_A=false, V_B&E_B=false, E_A&E_B=false. Metadata/geometric admission failure makes all pixels UNKNOWN, not O.
pixel_facts.known_class_A: V_A OR E_A, distinct from shared full_positive. For B use V_B OR E_B.

full_source_preparation_gate.split: All lab sessions TRAIN; all hall sessions VAL from immutable source split lock. A/B always same split.
full_source_preparation_gate.allowed: Generate and audit frozen conditional-teacher masks/certainty for all fixed50 pairs, preserving every diagnostic. No quality threshold optimization, per-pair residual selection, relabeling, model fit or current-evaluation access.
descriptive_only: strict25pixel Ecore and reverse speckle counts
full_source_preparation_gate.no_numeric_residual_admission_threshold: Residuals and coverage describe empirical support; they do not create a registration certificate or choose/drop a pair.
full_source_preparation_gate.failures: Preserve and report. No repair by fitting, alignment or mask/threshold changes. Any pair with a hard-check failure supplies UNKNOWN facts.
full_source_preparation_gate.fit_admission: HOLD until independent dataset/artifact review and a separate frozen training/source-evaluation protocol.

partial_label_storage.external_storage_encoding: If intake uses0=U,1=V,2=E, name that encoding explicitly and convert before joint-state training/evaluation.
partial_label_storage.U_training_policy: UNKNOWN is partial evidence, never a seventh class or an O/E hard negative. If later trained, use compatible joint-state likelihood and a separately frozen loss contract.
partial_label_storage.pure_helper: contract/paired_truth.py; constructs native erode2 teachers, symmetric evidence and correlated exact/r2 compatible sets.
partial_label_storage.semantic_self: UNKNOWN; geometry proxy, if used, remains separately named and supplied-pose-only.

official_geometry_reference.supported: Native pixel centers integer; RealSense depth is camera Z rather than Euclidean range; RGB/depth sensors have distinct intrinsic/extrinsic geometry and require explicit stream alignment.
official_geometry_reference.not_supported: This general manufacturer document does not certify this dataset underwent RGB-depth alignment or supply missing dataset calibration metadata.
